chunks: From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from Abdillah ibn Maymun, from Ja'far, from his father (peace be upon them both), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), when he went out for Friday prayer, would sit on the pulpit until the callers to prayer had finished.
ai.seo_question: When did the Prophet sit on the pulpit for Friday prayer?
ai.summary: This narration from the *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the Prophet’s (SAW) deliberate patience and adherence to the sanctity of the Adhan before delivering the Khutbah, establishing a key procedural norm for Friday prayers. In Shia jurisprudence, this practice underscores the importance of allowing the call to prayer to conclude fully, reflecting the reverence due to the divine announcement before the communal address. It serves as a foundational evidence for the timing of the Imam's ascent relative to the completion of the Adhan.
